details.detail: Sidewall panels and seams. Unchanged: smooth satin wall with a joint every second window, no gaps or z-fighting in s01, s02, s05, s09 or win_*.
F/J bowl. Unchanged and good. Width, short bowl and pill are right, the side walls are smooth, and the grade is darkest just above the opening.

PY/Y tub. Now an even hood ramp, 0.82 -> 0.64 of the pier (photo ~0.69), a lateral dip of 0.83 (photo 0.80) and a darker band under the lip. It matches sp_py14 closely. The lowest ~25 % above the bezel is flat rather than still darkening.
Pane, lining and seal. Unchanged. Pane size and ratio are right, and the lining is graded with a channel line. A few single-pixel bright specks show on the reveal rim at close range (s01 crop).

Electric shades. The blackout is now 0.61 of the sill (in range) with crisper pleats (amplitude 0.167 vs photo ~0.32). The hem meets the opening edge. The violet LED pill is right. Mild moire starts on the mid-distance windows in s05.
Manual PY/Y shades. Unchanged. The stowed band, grip and half/closed states read (ra_yWin, s08).
Floors. The carpets are unchanged and fine. The vinyl is now neutral with faint clouds, but the mottle is still about a quarter of sans_09's.

Type A door surround and viewing window. REGRESSED. The monuments lining housing (now mirrored, c-0.20..c+0.48, 0.12 m proud) covers the shell's viewing window at c+0.28 on every door, so no door has a visible window (b_doorWin, s06, s07, ra_door2floor; in w8 it was clear). A scratch build with wz = c - 0.28 brings it back next to the arrowhead (rb9/fix/b_doorWin.png), but the housing's forward edge then clips ~2 cm off the reveal's aft rim (rb9/cmp/doorwin_fix_crop.png).

issues.detail: Blackout pleats start to moire at mid distance
issues.problem: The crisper stripe (kf 0.62) on the 62-row zig-zag beats against the pixel grid on the 3rd-6th windows in s05 (diagonal bands). Close-up relief is still below the photo (0.167 vs ~0.32), so do not simply soften it.
issues.fix: Keep kf 0.62 for the near LOD; if the shade has a far instance set, use kf 0.75 there. Otherwise fade the baked stripe toward 1 with view distance in the shader via the layer roughness, or lower the zig-zag depth 6 -> 5 mm, which reduces the geometric part of the beat. Re-check win_oblique.
